snapshot.text: Decentralised system: two entities plus Brčko District, with 14 health ministries and 13 insurance funds, which makes reform complex. Social health insurance is mandatory but not universal, out-of-pocket payments are high, and primary care reform is under way.

priorities.title: Primary health care reform
priorities.text: Federation and Republika Srpska health leaders joined WHO-backed 2025 workshops aimed at shaping a new community-based primary care model.

priorities.title: Eurotransplant accession and transplant system
priorities.text: Accession to Eurotransplant is expected to address the long-standing shortage of organ transplants. A teaching agreement would allow limited organ exchange before full membership.

priorities.title: Medical cannabis regulation
priorities.text: Rules on which doctors may prescribe, which patients qualify and which pharmacies may dispense are still pending. The Federation health ministry was expected to present a first draft.
